title: “Draw an Ugly Person”: An Exploration of Generative AI’s Perceptions of Ugliness

bias_targets.methodology: Coding perceived gender (male, female, undefined) in AI-generated images prompted with ugliness-related adjectives versus their positive antonyms to observe representational disparities.
Coding perceived age categories (e.g., young adult, middle-aged, senior) in AI-generated images to analyze the correlation between aging and negative aesthetic traits.
Coding perceived race and ethnicity (White, People of Color, etc.) in AI-generated images to evaluate whether negative aesthetic traits are disproportionately assigned to specific demographic groups.
Evaluating perceived socioeconomic and lifestyle indicators, specifically hygiene levels (clean, neutral, unclean) and clothing styles, in AI-generated images of 'ugly' versus 'attractive' concepts.
